title: WHAT'S SO AMAZING ABOUT GRACE?
author: Chuck Fulmore
stanzas: If you have to ask the question "What's so amazing about grace?" Then you've never heard The story of the cross. If you ask what really happened When He died on Calvary, Then you do not know How much salvation cost

If you have to ask the question "Why did Mary wash His feet?" Then you've never known the joy forgiveness brings. If you ask what really happened When He arose up from the grave , Then you need to know we serve a living King

If you have to ask a question "What's this story about?" Then you need to know the man of Galilee. If you ask what really happened Why I gave my life to Him, Then you need to know He died for you and me.
chorus: I've been to Calvary I've seen the cross I've seen the agony of pain in His face I've seen the eyes of Jesus Look at me with love And I know what's amazing about grace.
